name: Application control Packaged App Rules: Appx collection enforcement posture (T1553)
blast_radius: Read-only: reads the AppLocker packaged-app (Appx) rule collection mode next to the other collections and counts installed packages. No package is installed or launched.
detection: Block event (enforced) or audit event (audit mode) correlated to this test window and artifact; audit events are recorded but never counted as prevention

name: Application control Packaged App Trust: sideloading and developer mode while enforcing (T1553)
blast_radius: Read-only: reads the AllowAllTrustedApps and AllowDevelopmentWithoutDevLicense settings and reports them only where application control is enforcing. Changes nothing.
telemetry: Registry values under Appx policy and AppModelUnlock
detection: Block event (enforced) or audit event (audit mode) correlated to this test window and artifact; audit events are recorded but never counted as prevention

name: Application control Installer Trust: AlwaysInstallElevated bypass (T1548)
blast_radius: Read-only: reads the AlwaysInstallElevated policy for machine and user. When both are 1, any MSI installs with SYSTEM rights, so MSI rules are not a boundary. Changes nothing.
detection: Block event (enforced) or audit event (audit mode) correlated to this test window and artifact; audit events are recorded but never counted as prevention

name: Application control Trusted Location Trust: user-writable directories under the Windows directory (T1553)
blast_radius: Read-only: reads the ACLs of well-known directories under the Windows directory that the default AppLocker path rule trusts and reports any that ordinary users can write. Nothing is written.
telemetry: File system ACLs under the Windows directory
detection: Block event (enforced) or audit event (audit mode) correlated to this test window and artifact; audit events are recorded but never counted as prevention
